message.jaymospowers.zfighter_pool_none: The water is still: no orb lies in the world right now.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_library_no: The lessons in these books are for those who fight with ki.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_library_un: The books hold nothing you have been taught. Learn from a good master first.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_library_po: A lesson bought back from the books costs %s TP.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_gravity_fu: The machine is full of fuel.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_capsule_bl: There is no room for it to open there.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_wish_remad: Your story is unmade. Tell it again.
Your look is made anew: a new ki colour, and your aura and ki weapon start plain.
There was nothing of you to remake.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_wish_racia: The gift of your blood is made new: its cool-downs, reserves and scars are gone.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_wish_resta: Every stat level you bought is undone and %s TP are yours again. Spend them as you like.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_wish_diffi: Difficulty: %1$s. You take %2$s%% of the damage.
wish.jaymospowers.zfighter.remake.desc: With Jaymo's Kingdoms your story, class and heritage are unmade and asked again, and a Z Fighter's lineage follows the new heritage. Without it, your look is redone: a new ki colour, the aura and ki weapon back to plain.
wish.jaymospowers.zfighter.racial.desc: A Z Fighter's lineage extras start over: the Earthling's adrenaline cool-down, the Frost-born's ki reserve, the Warrior-born's comebacks, a cut tail and a crippled ape.
wish.jaymospowers.zfighter.restat.desc: Every stat level you bought with TP is undone and the TP are paid back; the levels your training raised stay. Then spend them again on the training screen.
wish.jaymospowers.zfighter.difficulty.sh: Change how hard you are hit
wish.jaymospowers.zfighter.difficulty.de: Steps your own dial: normal, harder (you take 135% of every blow), brutal (175%), easier (75%), then normal again. Only you are affected.
If a mad scientist rebuilt you, the rebuild is taken back: ki costs, ki regeneration and ki attacks as they were, and the android forms close.
